newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel sees 1999 cashflow 2.6 bln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel sees 1999 cashflow 2.6 bln Ffr.

text.p: Eurotunnel forecast available cashflow of 2,557 million francs ($444.7 million) for 1999 in a base scenario described on Thursday in a restructuring prospectus presented to shareholders and banks.
It had 1996 cashflow of 642 million francs and its lower-case scenario forecast for 1999 was for cashflow of 2,176 million.
Co-chairman Patrick Ponsolle told a news conference turnover should increase by 10 percent a year over the next three years.
The debt service under the restructuring plan would total around 3.5 billion francs in 2003, compared with 1996 financial charges of 5.5 billion.
